profile.summary: Tandem, Partners in Early Learning is a Bay Area nonprofit that works on early childhood education. It partners with school districts, early childhood providers and community organizations to build early learning experiences for children ages 0-5. Its programs include StoryCycles, Read & Play Club, Early Learning Everywhere and Network Capacity Building.
